draft.briefing: Hey, you're in Thenmala! It's home to the first ecotourism centre in India. The name means 'Honey hill', and the area is known for exporting high-quality honey.
draft.hungryLine: Thenmala means honey hill, so pick up some local honey while you're here.

moodReplies.show-me-around: Walk to Thenmala Dam for a boat ride on the reservoir, then cross the hanging bridge.
moodReplies.somewhere-to-chill: Take a slow boat out on the dam's reservoir and let the forest hills surround you.
moodReplies.surprise-me: The Malayalam film Adiverukal (1986) was shot here, the same year the dam was commissioned.

legends.title: The honey hill
legends.body: In Malayalam, then means honey and mala means mountain. The name sticks because the hills here are still known for their honey.

legends.title: The temple fish pond
legends.body: Kulathupuzha, 10 km south on the road to Shencottah, has a well-known Ayyappa temple. Its temple fish pond is part of the tradition there.

tips.title: Come by train.
tips.body: Thenmala has its own railway station, though Kollam and Sengottai are better connected.

tips.title: Book a boat ride.
tips.body: Boating on the dam reservoir is the classic thing to do here.

story.title: A big water plan
story.body: Work on the dam began under the Kallada Irrigation and Tree Crop development project, the largest irrigation project in Kerala.

story.title: First stone
story.body: T. K. Divakaran laid the foundation stone of the dam on the Kallada River.

story.title: The dam opens
story.body: K. Karunakaran commissioned Thenmala Dam, also called Parappar Dam, for irrigation and power. The same year, the film Adiverukal was shot here.

story.title: India's first ecotourism centre
story.body: The reservoir is now part of the Thenmala Ecotourism Project, with boating, a rope bridge, trekking and a musical fountain.
